main_body: Flat grass ground patch (about 4x1 tiles of green grass) with a few small bush clumps and tiny flowers; terrain tile, not a standing object
top_band: none - ground surface with no top/front structure; mid green grass with scattered lighter and darker pixel speckles
evidence: The candidate is a flat grass terrain patch seen from above. It has no standing volume, so the 3/4 top-and-front contract does not apply. Reading a column shows only grass tones with sparse speckle and dark clump pixels. No side faces are drawn and nothing is a front elevation. For terrain the ground plane is the correct depiction, so nothing in this part fails.

style.evidence: The grass uses a mid green base with sparse light and dark single-pixel dots, about 3 tones. The reference grass has about 5 steps, with dense mottled tufts and shaded clumps in several greens. Here large areas of 5x5 pixels or more are a single flat green. The small bush clumps do have 3-4 greens, but they are sparse and the dark tones are limited. The tiles are mostly 2-4 colours, well under the reference density of about 10 colours per tile. It would look thinner and flatter next to the reference.
